html:
Jeep driving on sand in Mui Ne is one of the most exciting experiences for travelers visiting this coastal destination. With a classic open air jeep, you can explore the vast sand dunes, enjoy stunning landscapes, and capture unforgettable photos.

This tour is suitable for couples, families, and small groups who want a flexible and fun outdoor experience.

Experience the Sand Dunes by Jeep

During the jeep driving tour in Mui Ne, you will have the opportunity to visit the most famous attractions, such as:

  • White Sand Dunes

  • Red Sand Dunes

  • Fairy Stream

  • Fishing Village and coastal viewpoints

Driving on the sand by jeep allows you to enjoy fresh air, open views, and a unique sense of adventure that regular vehicles cannot offer.

Flexible Tour Schedule

You can choose the tour time based on your preference:

  • Early morning for sunrise views at the sand dunes

  • Late afternoon for sunset and cooler weather

The itinerary can be adjusted slightly depending on weather conditions and your travel schedule.

Professional Driver and Safe Jeep

The jeep is driven by an experienced local driver who is familiar with the sand terrain and sightseeing routes. Safety and comfort are always prioritized during the tour.
